result.stdout:
Description:
  Gatewright: manage your API gateway from the command line.

Usage:
  gatewright [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  login     Store the control plane address and an access token for the next commands.
  api       Manage APIs.
  config    Export, import and validate whole configurations (GitOps).
  publish   Validate and publish a revision to an environment.
  rollback  Restore a previously published revision in an environment.
  nodes     List data plane nodes and the configuration version each applied.

result.stdout:
Description:
  Store the control plane address and an access token for the next commands.

Usage:
  gatewright login [options]

Options:
  --server <server> (REQUIRED)  Base address of the Gatewright control plane, for example https://gatewright.example.com.
  --token <token>               Bearer token for the Admin API (for example from 'az account get-access-token --resource api://gatewright-admin'). Read from the GATEWRIGHT_TOKEN variable or the standard input when omitted.
  --no-verify                   Save the settings without calling the server.
  -?, -h, --help                Show help and usage information

result.stdout:
Description:
  Create or update an API from an OpenAPI document (draft revision; publish with 'gatewright publish').

Usage:
  gatewright api import <openapi> [options]

Arguments:
  <openapi>  OpenAPI 3.0/3.1/3.2 document: a file, an http(s) URL, or '-' for the standard input.

Options:
  --name <name>                API name (default: x-gateway.name or the document title).
  --base-path <base-path>      Base path (default: x-gateway.basePath or the first server path).
  --service <service>          Kubernetes service backend: namespace/name:port.
  --destination <destination>  Static backend destination URL; repeat for several.
  --product <product>          Product the API belongs to; repeat for several.
  --keep-missing               Keep operations that the document no longer declares.
  --dry-run                    Show what would change without changing anything.
  --json                       Print the raw JSON report.
  -?, -h, --help               Show help and usage information

  Validate a configuration offline, with the same rules as the control plane (structure, references, built-in policy schemas).

Usage:
  gatewright config validate <file> [options]

Arguments:
  <file>  A configuration or a document produced by 'config export' ('-' for the standard input).

Options:
  --allow-unknown-policies  Do not fail on policy types this CLI does not know (custom policies).
  -?, -h, --help            Show help and usage information
